items.name: Empty scroll
items.description: Blank vellum. Bind a spell item to it at the scriptorium and the spell goes in your grimoire.

items.name: Fireball
items.description: A good old fireball. Everything starts here.

items.name: Small heal
items.description: Closes small wounds. Bigger ones need a bigger spell.

items.name: Minor teleport
items.description: Blink to a spot you can see. Walls are not an opinion it respects.

items.name: Barrier
items.description: A shell of force that takes a few hits for you.

items.name: Grimoire
items.description: Your spellbook. It has your name on it and no one else's.
